voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: Dad's royal school was like a beautiful jail. All day long, Luna had to practise curtsies and balance books on her head. Worst of all, they made her wear a big, frilly, itchy dress. Luna missed her hoodie. She missed Cheeto more. But Luna was clever, and she watched, and she waited. She noticed something. The teachers were allowed to leave the school — but the students were not. So when her teacher went out to buy some lunch, Luna saw her chance. She crept up to the locked door and its glowing keypad. She cracked her knuckles. Her fingers began to fly.

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: Beep — beep — click! The door slid open. Luna slipped out to go and rescue her best friend.
